decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program uses existing psychiatric staff and facilities, is still presented on its own page, and its demand from working patients is not yet fully revealed, so keeping this low-cost option open remains worthwhile.
The custom-furniture carpentry runs on existing sheltered-workshop know-how and equipment at little extra cost, and its market value is still emerging, so the option stays open.
Senior living counseling costs little, fits growing demographic demand, and its prominent placement signals favorable early results, which justifies further commitment.
The retail shop carries fixed running costs and gets little visibility, but it supports workshop and carpentry sales and has had only two years to prove itself, so it is kept under closer watch.
Meal delivery for seniors launched only in 2024 and builds on existing kitchen and care logistics, so its uncertainty is still high and keeping this early option open costs little.
